deficits.evidence: No purpose-built sidewalk; pedestrians must walk in the roadway.
deficits.suggestion: Construct a continuous sidewalk on the left side to separate pedestrians from vehicle traffic.

deficits.evidence: No purpose-built sidewalk; area is occupied by parked vehicles and building fronts.
deficits.suggestion: Create a dedicated pedestrian footway on the right side to improve safety.

deficits.evidence: Residential and commercial properties on both sides create crossing demand, but no designated facility exists.
deficits.suggestion: Install a marked pedestrian crossing to provide a safe point for people to cross the street.

ratings.reason: The left side consists of a wall and roadway with no dedicated footway.
The right side is too narrow and constrained by buildings and parked cars to realistically build a footway.
No marked crossing is visible, though the suggestion is a generic one for any street.
